title: 第一卷 第1322章 黑暗神庭游猎者第一卷 第1321章 遭遇偷袭
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：九天轮回诀第一卷第1322章黑暗神庭，游猎者！
（..la）想到高兴处，我不由傻笑了起来，到了那个时候，我大概就是所有武士的克星了吧，你一刀砍过来，我一点没感觉，对方却要承受与自己攻击同样能量的反震，这不是无敌是什么？
想到这里，我不由的提出了我的疑问，面对着我的疑问，艾迪修萨和阿兰克斯，还有血狼不由愣住了，随后三人不约而同的仰天大笑了起来。
姜寒松开捏着石拓聃腕子的手，朝着石拓聃随意的招了招手，示意他继续。
我怎么可能给它这机会，手里青钢桃木剑一甩，暗嚣一扣！
一张乌丝精钢网瞬间便弹射了出去，又把那血尸给捆了个结实。
“行了。”
吴庸直接挥手阻止了唐大国继续说下去，唐大国正想说话，却被吴庸突然阻止了，就像憋了一口气在胸口，难受得吐血。
不等血影将身体停稳，光剑己经灵巧无比的一个转折，完全违背了物理学常识的一个凌空回旋后，再次犀利的朝血影刺了过去。
华定邦走到诸葛阳的轿车旁边，伸出手摆了摆，示意那些保镖在机场大厅休息，原地待命。
我一拍脑门子，墩子说得对，可说出去的话，泼出去的水！
再说了，成大事，手底下没几个能人哪成！
这瞎子老道凭我的感觉道行不浅，留着日后必定有用。
四猴子赶忙点头答应，转身出去了，不大一会，就拎了一把椅子过来，递给了姜寒。
大白天能来来常宁的家，对肖兰是一种莫大的刺激，下了车，她便把自己挂到了常宁的身，捧着常宁的脸狂吻不已。
荣叔很支持王浩明出去闯荡一番，也没有出言挽留，这两个月之中，荣叔已经将自己沉浸在古玩数十年的经验和体会，都教给了王浩明。
原本等在马车边上的宣禾，却也不知什么时候，已经来到古庙之内。
悄然来到自家阳台，江海一跃而下，想起自己好久没和沐颜宁静亲热过了，随即从沐颜宁静的窗户钻了进去，江海当然没有别的意思，就是想和沐颜宁静聊聊天什么的，顺便计划一下到了帝都的事。
只是此刻的赵子弦，被老人那厚重的声音震撼的楞在当场。
当他回过神的时候，却发现了一件更奇妙的事情。
“好了，别闹了。
晚点我还要出去。”
赵子弦放下冉瑶，一脸认真地说。
夏浩然抬手对着房门轻轻一挥，一个无形的力道用过，房间的大门随即打开。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1322 of the first volume of Nine Heavens Reincarnation Art, Dark Divine Court, the Hunter!
(..la) Thinking of the joy, I couldn't help but giggle. At that time, I will probably be the nemesis of all samurai. You slash at me with a knife, and I don't feel it at all, but the other party has to bear the repercussions of the same energy as my attack. What is this if not invincible?
Thinking of this, I couldn't help but raise my question. Facing my question, Adixusa, Alanks, and the Blood Wolf couldn't help but froze, and then the three of them looked up to the sky and laughed in unison.
Jiang Han released his hand from Shi Tuotan's wrist and waved at Shi Tuotan casually, indicating for him to continue.
How could I give it this chance? I swung the green steel and peach wood sword in my hand, and made a secret clamor!
A black silk mesh was ejected instantly, and the bloody corpse was tied up tightly.
"Okay."
Wu Yong directly waved his hand to stop Tang Daguo from continuing. Tang Daguo was about to speak, but was suddenly stopped by Wu Yong, as if he was holding a breath in his chest and was so uncomfortable that he vomited blood.
Before the blood shadow could stop its body, the lightsaber made an extremely dexterous turn, and after a volley that completely violated the common sense of physics, it stabbed the blood shadow sharply again.
Hua Dingbang walked to Zhuge Yang's car and waved his hand, signaling the bodyguards to rest in the airport lobby and stay put.
I slapped my forehead, and Dunzi was right, but if he said it out loud, it would be a splash of water!
Besides, if you don’t have many capable people at your disposal, you can’t accomplish anything big!
According to my feeling, this blind old man is very knowledgeable and will definitely be useful in the future if I keep it.
The four monkeys quickly nodded in agreement, turned around and went out. After a while, they brought a chair over and handed it to Jiang Han.
Being able to come to Chang Ning's home in broad daylight was a great stimulation for Xiao Lan. After getting out of the car, she hung herself on Chang Ning's body, holding Chang Ning's face and kissing her wildly.
Uncle Rong was very supportive of Wang Haoming's adventure and did not say anything to persuade him to stay. In the past two months, Uncle Rong had taught Wang Haoming all his decades of experience and experience in antiques.
Xuanhe, who was originally waiting beside the carriage, arrived at the ancient temple at some unknown time.
Quietly coming to his balcony, Jiang Hai jumped down, remembering that he hadn't been intimate with Mu Yan Ning Ning for a long time, and then got in through Mu Yan Ning Ning's window. Of course, Jiang Hai had no other intention, he just wanted to chat with Mu Yan Ning Ning and make plans for his arrival in the imperial capital.
But at this moment, Zhao Zixian was stunned by the old man's thick voice.
When he came to his senses, he discovered something even more amazing.
"Okay, stop making trouble.
I have to go out later. "
Zhao Zixian put down Ran Yao and said seriously.
Xia Haoran raised his hand and waved lightly at the door. An invisible force was used, and the door of the room opened immediately.
